notes: Three independent zero-state episodes per client, total 6 or 24 s. Nested prefixes and measurement-noise draws. Restricted support assigned independently of family with equal category counts per family. Same nominal global data-collection controller for everyone. Output-error fit in vy coordinates, beta/r output noise only, exact inputs/speed, no process noise. Evaluate same physical clients on held-out 24-s moderate trajectories over 10--30 m/s. Local/global/oracle-family pooling share the same available dataset. Primary gate: noisy short restricted, family tracking >=5% better than local, positive paired CI, family amplitude feasible and frozen rho<1. No federation or learned clustering.
